summary: The Form 8-K announces the results of a Technical Report Summary Initial Assessment for Paramount Gold Nevada Corp.'s Sleeper Gold Project, filed under Items 7.01 and 8.01. The filing is a routine disclosure of a technical report and press release, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. The report outlines project economics but does not trigger any M&A, restructuring, or capital event. The filing is purely informational and regulatory, with no deal terms or special-situation mechanics to analyze.
